topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I heard that Eli’s been telling tales 'bout his work in the town. Turns out, his hands are just as calloused as mine, yet he spun stories of fine gloves and silken threads. I cannot help but wonder what other seeds he sowed that have yet to sprout. The ground we till is honest, and it gives what it gets. If the soil lies, the harvest fails. What does a man reap when he plants deceit? The winters are harsh enough without the frost of a friend’s deceit. I best keep my eyes on my own field, and my tongue on my own thoughts. Saints preserve us, for the road ahead looks uncertain.
